description: May 2 Volleyball & Food DriveThanks to everyone that came out to Fairmont Park yesterday for our great event! We served hot dogs, chips, soft drinks and cookies to over 50 people. In addition to enjoying a meal together, folks played cornhole and Can Jam in between assembling meal and snack kits for needy kids at Granite Schools. As a result of this event, we were able to provide 394 snack kits, and 76 meal kits for our kids! (Each meal kit provides four weekend meals and a snack for one student
